subject: System
action: The screen must provide a navigation link from /studio/:workId to /studio/{workId}/chapters.
condition: WHEN the user clicks the '회차 목록으로 이동' link
expectedOutcome: The user navigates to the chapter list for the current work.

subject: System
action: The screen must render work?.title for the heading and use work?.synopsis || '' for the synopsis area.
condition: While the work detail screen is rendering
expectedOutcome: If no work or synopsis is available, the page shows unpopulated title content and an empty synopsis area instead of confirmed alternate UI.

subject: System
action: The screen must fetch work data only when a current Supabase user exists, and the work lookup must be filtered by both owner_id and id.
condition: WHEN the /studio/:workId page mounts and attempts to load the work detail
expectedOutcome: Only the current user's matching work record is requested for display on the page.

subject: authenticated user
action: Review a work's core details and continue to chapter-level work.
